name: Auto Daily Macro Report

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 23 * * *' # Chạy tự động 06:00 sáng giờ VN hàng ngày
  workflow_dispatch: # Cho phép kích hoạt bằng tay trên Web

jobs:
  build-and-update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20' 

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cd scripts
          npm install

      - name: Generate current Month-Year variable
        id: date
        run: echo "MONTH=$(date +'%Y-%m')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Call AI to fetch data and write report.json
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
        run: node scripts/auto_ai.js

      - name: Verify data integrity
        run: node scripts/verify_data.js --json=${{ env.MONTH }}/report.json --history=history.json

      - name: Render new HTML Web
        run: node scripts/render.js --json=${{ env.MONTH }}/report.json --history=history.json --out=index.html

      - name: Commit and Push to GitHub
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          git diff-index --quiet HEAD || git commit -m "auto: AI cap nhat du lieu ngay $(date +'%Y-%m-%d') [skip ci]"
          git push
